structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Payment of interest on debt of University; sinking fund
law.text: Out of the appropriation made by the General Assembly for the support of the University, there shall be first set apart, annually, a sum sufficient to pay the interest accruing on the existing interest-bearing debt of the University, except as provided in § 23.1-1109, and to constitute a sinking fund for the liquidation of the principal of such debt. Such sum shall be applied to no other purpose or object.
